C0420.title: Selling Ticket-Snatching Tools Is Illegal! Suspect Arrested!
C0420.summary: In October 2024, Taiyuan police cracked a case involving illegal ticket-snatching tools. The suspect, Miao, sold plug-in programs via short-video platforms for prices ranging from 268 to 888 yuan. These tools could tamper with the 'passcode' of ticketing platforms, providing users—including numerous fans and scalpers—with early access to official ticket sales channels.
